backend_rule: with no explicit option, KILIX_ASK_COMMANDS_BACKEND or saved Ask selection, Ask uses lfm2 when the catalog's lfm2-kilix-commands asset is installed with a covering receipt, otherwise grammar

manifest.note: The final kilix-content catalog selects delivery lfm2-kilix-commands-20261115-v10 and weight lfm2-kilix-v5e1-wse-20261106.9, with the v10 modified-model notice (ad951c96) recorded by kilix-license. The weight and the CPU runtime build are those of delivery lfm2-kilix-commands-20261106-v9, byte for byte; v10 omits v9's ten duplicate copies of five versioned runtime libraries. None of the commits is published yet.

offered_by: the first interactive kilix ask that reaches the command route
the Kilix model wizard's Local Workflows / Kilix Ask page
delivery.non_interactive: a non-interactive Ask never asks and never downloads
delivery.decline: declining keeps the grammar and is remembered as the saved Ask selection
delivery.agreement: notice terms by the owner's 2026-11-07 determination: an install records a notice receipt that claims no agreement; the terms, including the commercial-use limitation, are shipped with the model under its notices/ directory and not waived. The first-use offer shows them before the download; the upgrade's local migration shows nothing, because it runs unattended, and records the same notice receipt Kilix's non-interactive path records, only where the user's v9 install already holds a receipt for the same licence record; it prints where the installed terms are. Terms that need a typed agreement are never answered by Plebian-OS

local_migration.requires: the desktop user's installed v9 directory and a receipt that covers it
local_migration.verification: Content's supplied-directory install verifies every file against the v10 manifest; licence notices come from the licence authority
local_migration.on_failure: nothing is installed and the upgrade continues, whatever the cause: a catalog that does not select this delivery, missing or different v9 files or receipt, a partial v10 directory, too little space, or a receipt store or installer that refuses. A receipt the run wrote is withdrawn if the install then fails. Kilix Ask offers the download on first use
local_migration.older_deliveries: not migrated; their weight is not this one, so they get the first-use offer

delivery.release_note: The release asset is not uploaded yet; publication belongs to the release session.

rollback.mechanism: the previous catalog selects its retained manifest-specific v9 directory and covering receipt; the migration neither removes nor changes them. A machine that had no v9 installed has no LFM2 to roll back to and stays on the grammar.
rollback.staged_archive: an archive an earlier release staged under /usr/local/share/kilix/model-archives, and its licence documents under /usr/local/share/doc/plebian-os/models, are left in place

quality.scope: Ask suites for weight 20261106.9, GPU against 20261106.8, and CPU with the product CPU runtime. No general ranking.
